assessment.label: Incomplete analysis — review available evidence
assessment.summary: A final review conclusion is unavailable. Retained indicators and observations remain useful.
assessment.scope: Static inspection and selected sandbox behavior.
incomplete_reasons: Job status is failed; this is not a completed analysis.
Sandbox execution did not produce a completed final result.
Required runtime coverage is unverified: file, database, account, cron, network.

limitations: Static indicators are not proof of maliciousness or safety.
No plugin execution, dynamic monitoring, or runtime observations in Phase 1.
PHP checks are lexical, not AST, data-flow, reachability, or vulnerability analysis.
Raw YARA may match comments or inert strings; encoded/indirect behavior can evade rules.
Only the configured local hash references are checked; an empty catalog provides no known-sample detection.
Observed activity is not by itself proof of maliciousness; compare clean controls.
Inotify captures transient events but not the deleted contents; watch-creation races are possible.
Database audit records attempted mutation SQL; successful state changes require snapshot corroboration.
Network coverage includes WordPress HTTP hooks, controlled HTTP receipts and DNS sink attempts, not complete syscall tracing.
Plugins can spoof or disable application HTTP telemetry; external collectors are separate.
Direct-IP or alternative-protocol failures without DNS/HTTP telemetry may not produce network evidence.
Containers share the Docker Linux kernel; this prototype is not a VM-level malware detonation platform.
Only the predefined actions and finite observation window are exercised.
Severity and review rules are explainable heuristics, not a malware probability or validation of intent.
Recorded timestamps are observation times; ordering does not prove causation.
A clean-control pattern match never proves that an individual event is benign.

policy.title: Static review indicators
policy.condition: A configured static rule has medium or high severity.
policy.limitation: A matching pattern is not proof of reachable or malicious code.

policy.title: Administrator privilege change
policy.condition: An account snapshot shows a new administrator, or a transition into administrator privileges.
policy.limitation: Provisioning tools can legitimately create administrators. Identity and authorization require review.

policy.title: Sensitive WordPress file change
policy.condition: A file is written, deleted or moved into a core/configuration path, or a PHP file outside the submitted plugin, after installation.
policy.limitation: Legitimate maintenance may change these files; an event does not establish intent.

policy.title: Incomplete observation takes precedence
policy.condition: The job or a required analysis stage is incomplete, evidence is inconsistent, or required coverage/cleanup is unverified.
policy.limitation: Recorded review indicators remain visible even when a final assessment cannot be completed.

policy.title: Control patterns do not erase evidence
policy.condition: A selected control also records a normalized runtime pattern.
policy.limitation: Shared patterns may have different values or causes; matching never discounts review indicators.
